svg.title: CassChat deployed system architecture - Group 4
svg.text: CassChat deployment as run for Experiments 1-6 (docker-compose.yml, Cassandra 5.0.8)
Peer-to-peer cluster: no master node. Any node coordinates any request; seeds only help gossip bootstrap.
Host: Windows 11 laptop, WSL2 Ubuntu, Docker Desktop
Makefile targets: up, schema, smoke, exp1-exp6,
One node at a time, under traffic
detect_down.py: tails docker logs -t of a
static node IPs; dynamic IPs from 172.28.1.0/24
load generator: write | read | mixed, rate, CL
1 write + 1 read per CL every 250 ms
sends each request to a replica of the
request timeout 5 s; no speculative exec.
CL set per statement: ONE | QUORUM | ALL,
SERIAL for the LWT Paxos phase (Exp 6)
Cassandra cluster inft6000-g4 - DC dc1 / rack1
RF = N = 3: every partition on all 3 nodes
next request may use any node
driver connects to every node (any can coordinate)
docker kill | stop | start | network disconnect/connect cassN
docker exec cassN nodetool ... / cqlsh; docker logs -t cassN
Results on host filesystem (bind-mounted into client at /work/results)
one row per operation: time, CL, op,
